subject: Your FF Digest

disagreements.detail: High expert disagreement: rank 6-20 (std 3.06) -- highest: Mike Harmon (#5), lowest: Nathan Jahnke (#21)

news.title: Isaiah Rodgers Sr. (quad) ruled out for Week 12
news.impact: Rodgers remains week-to-week with a quad injury.

news.title: Christian Darrisaw (shoulder) ruled out for Week 12
news.impact: Darrisaw will remain sidelined with a shoulder injury for the Vikings.

news.title: Juwan Johnson (hamstring/wrist) ruled out for Week 12
news.impact: Johnson will not suit up after being unable to practice, with Noah Fant and Oscar Delp in line for increased snaps against the Bengals for head coach Kellen Moore Sunday.

news.title: Jordan Addison (thumb) ruled out for Week 12
news.impact: Addison continues to work back from a thumb injury for head coach Kevin O'Connell, with Tai Felton, Jauan Jennings, and Myles Price to see increased snaps behind WR1 Justin Jefferson against the Falcons.

news.title: Will Mallory (hamstring) ruled out for Week 12
news.impact: Mallory will remain sidelined with a hamstring injury.

narrative: Quiet week on the movement front, with just one storyline worth your attention: Dak Prescott has the experts talking past each other. His rankings stretch from #6 all the way down to #20, with a standard deviation of 3.06 — that's a real split, not rounding noise. Mike Harmon is highest on him at #5, while Nathan Jahnke has him buried at #21. If you're starting Dak this week, you're essentially picking a side in that argument.
